summary: Frontend-only regression on File Mind offline app (web preview at http://localhost:3000, mobile viewport 390x844). Home is the default route with logo/tagline/search/Quick Tools/Storage/Recent/bottom tabs. Zero Emergent branding and zero notification-permission UI on any surface (Home, Settings, Tools, PDF, Files, AI, Privacy, Terms). Import from Home (Import a file CTA) and from Tools (tool-import) both open a native file chooser. Images→PDF (tool-images_to_pdf) and OCR (tool-ocr) tools are present and wired to their respective flows. Safe-Back verified on 12 deep routes (/pdf-viewer, /ocr, /scanner, /settings, /tools, /vault, /storage, /duplicates, /organize, /trash, /privacy, /terms) — all render without crash; header back button falls back to Home when no history and NEVER throws GO_BACK. Only benign RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents). Web-preview limitations flagged as non-bugs: pdf-viewer/ocr WebViews are gated by Platform.OS !== 'web'; expo-file-system.documentDirectory is null on web so real file persistence/PDF/OCR must be validated on Expo Go or a native build.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow). Origin appears to be shared UI components / react-native-web. Reference: browser console during initial render.
'props.pointerEvents' is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Reference: browser console during initial render.

action_items: No functional fixes required from web preview. All requested checks passed.

Native validation required on Expo Go / dev build for the following since expo-file-system.documentDirectory is null on web: (a) importInto/copyFile persistence into ROOT (FileMind/), (b) pdf-viewer renders bundled pdf.js WebView and Save/Share succeed, (c) Images→PDF via pdf-lib produces a real PDF that appears in the Files list, (d) OCR Tesseract WebView returns extracted text or a clear error, (e) Save/Share on file-viewer uses StorageAccessFramework on Android / native share sheet on iOS.
Optional: audit 'shadow*' style usages and remaining pointerEvents props in shared UI (e.g., src/components/ui.tsx) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: useSafeBack (src/hooks/use-safe-back.ts) correctly wraps router.canGoBack() with try/catch and falls back to router.replace('/') — this is applied via ScreenHeader and viewer-back in pdf-viewer.tsx.
app/index.tsx redirects to /(tabs), and (tabs)/index.tsx is Home — root route resolves to Home as required.

src/lib/fs.ts uses expo-file-system/legacy and gracefully no-ops when documentDirectory is null (HAS_FS=false), so web preview does not crash even though write operations correctly throw a caught error surfaced as a toast.

src/lib/file-actions.ts saveCopy path uses StorageAccessFramework on Android and falls back to shareFile on iOS/web; on web Sharing.isAvailableAsync() returns false → thrown error is caught in pdf-viewer/file-viewer and displayed as a toast (graceful fallback, per spec).
src/lib/pdf.ts lazy-imports pdf-lib via dynamic import so the crypto polyfill only loads on-demand — good for web bundling.
No Expo Notifications import found; toast.tsx only uses expo-haptics Haptics.notificationAsync for tactile feedback (not a UI notification).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of web-verifiable checks (Home default route, no Emergent branding, no notifications UI, file import chooser opens from Home + Tools, Images→PDF + OCR tools present, 12/12 deep routes render + safe-back works, no console errors beyond known RN Web warnings)
